items.title: Opening Night Worship
items.caption: The congregation lifts their hands in praise during the electric opening night service.
items.alt: Hundreds of young people raising hands in worship during a dramatic night service with purple stage lighting

items.title: Morning Devotion
items.caption: Young believers gather under the trees for morning prayer and Bible study.
items.alt: Group of young Africans sitting outdoors in a circle for morning devotion with Bibles

items.title: Fellowship & Community
items.caption: Joy and laughter — new friendships forged at the camp that last a lifetime.
items.alt: Joyful group of young African Christians laughing and embracing at the camp with tents in background

items.title: The Word Preached
items.caption: Powerful messages that cut to the heart, bringing conviction and transformation.
items.alt: Passionate preacher on stage at a youth conference with scripture displayed on the screen behind

items.title: United in Intercession
items.caption: Dozens gather in a prayer circle at sunset — one voice rising to Heaven.
items.alt: Large group of young Africans standing in a prayer circle at golden hour in an open field

items.title: Camp Grounds at Dusk
items.caption: The camp comes alive as evening falls — tents glowing, string lights twinkling overhead.
items.alt: Aerial view of camp meeting grounds at dusk with illuminated white tents and string lights
